patch_description: Focus proposals on vertices participating in the current smallest-area triangles, since these near-collinear triples are the active constraints limiting the maximin objective. In addition to the existing occasional global shake, introduce deterministic-probability coordinated two-point moves from the union of vertices in the eight worst triangles. Such moves are important because a single bottleneck vertex often cannot move alone without immediately making another triple limiting. The proposal remains annealed and fully reproducible through the existing seeded generator.
